**ParFold Release**

This release introduces ParFold: a composite plug that applies a single reducer across N candidates in parallel and collapses the N results into a single outcome using a hybrid deterministic-and-semantic judge. Everything else—clean-desk spawning, message boundary queuing, journal fork retirement—is infrastructure supporting or refining that core capability.
